what: Text starts with !=*+/?<>Scrambled with %#&@ and digits, then once visible it resolves into the right letters one by one from the front over 1.4s (the remaining part reshuffles every frame) · with speed it sweeps from the left edge in px per second while resolving (450px/s on one site), and look: dim makes the letters faint before they resolve · with repeat it rests that long after fully resolving, then scrambles and resolves again (2s on one site) · order: random makes each letter resolve by chance, flickering here and there before settling (.5s on another)

options.chars: Scramble character set, default !=*+/?<>%#&@0123456789 — Name is A!B@C#D$E%F&G*H?J[K]L{M}N=O+P-QRSTUVWXYZ
options.on: scroll (default — when visible) · load (right on load, after delay) · hover (shows its own text at first, and scrambles then resolves only on hover — signal-a footer link) · manual (does not start by itself, only when fx:play is sent — the menu drawer rewritten each time it opens)
options.delay: Seconds to wait before the first write begins (load, scroll and fx:play alike), default 0
options.each: In the life type, the per-letter stagger in seconds — when set, the total length follows the text length as life + each×(letter count − 1) instead of duration. The band site (shuffleLetters 20fps, 2-letter window) uses life: .1; each: .05
options.fx:play: Send this event to an element and it rewrites from the initial form (lead: blank means empty) after the delay
options.hold: Share held fully mixed (0~1), default 0 — then releases from the front
options.speed: If set, instead of letter order it reveals by sweeping from the element’s left edge at speed px per second (multi-line text moves together for the same x) — duration is width/speed. 450 for Brand
options.mix: In width mode, letters are shuffled among same-width groups (i·l, m·w, Hangul syllables for Korean) so line breaks don’t jitter while shuffling · in case mode, uppercase shuffles with A–Z·0–9, lowercase with a–z·0–9, and any other character with letters (the character classes of shuffleLetters)
options.flicker: Interval (seconds) for re-shuffling the mixed side, default 0 (every frame) — brand uses .03
options.look: If dim, the mixed side fades to 30% of the text color (Brand’s light-gray text before decoding)
options.fade: when on, the whole text opacity also fades up from 0 → 1 while mixing (brand)
options.repeat: Interval in seconds to rest as the original text after fully resolving, then scramble-resolve again, default 0 (once) — Brand corner text uses 2
options.order: With random, instead of resolving from the front, each character at each frame shows its final letter with a probability equal to the progress (all mixed → patchy → all resolved) — a reference site uses duration: .5; chars: ABSDabsd0123456789; order: random; start: top bottom
options.life: Blend time per letter (seconds) — if given, each letter blends and resolves in order from the front (stagger gap = (duration − life)/(letter count − 1)). signal-a has duration: .4; life: .06; flicker: .02
options.lead: If blank, letters before their turn are empty (they’re written mixing in from blanks — signal-a)
options.hover: If on, it reshuffles and resolves again without blanks each time the pointer hovers (signal-a menu · Work titles)
options.steps: Text is written in chunks of N characters from the start — for each chunk, only those N characters scramble for duration ÷ number of chunks while the rest stays empty. Default 0 (none) · david-brand banner steps: 2; duration: .6, About text steps: 3; duration: .7, tech title steps: 1; duration: .35 — chars: ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789
options.idle: If full, before writing it hides itself transparently with all its characters already in place (keeping space and height), then clears and turns on when it starts. The clearing happens one step (each) before the delay. Sending fx:rest returns it to that resting state (when the menu closes). Brand site .typewrite·.typewrite-menu
options.fx:rest: idle: stops what was used in full and returns to its own letters·transparent
options.space: If skip, blanks don’t take a turn (life type — only the letters go in order, like shuffleLetters)
options.jitter: In the life type, a random 0 to jitter seconds is added to each letter’s turn, default 0 — Brand work titles use each: .036; life: .072; jitter: .028
